description_en: Removes tags from resources. Instance resources are supported
description_zh: 删除资源标签。当前支持实例 Instance 资源
kebab_example: aliyun cr untag-resources --resource-type Instance --resource-id cri-8qong6ve5p3m0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --tag-key test-key --all true --region cn-hangzhou
name: UntagResources

parameters.help_en: The type of the resources. Instance resources are supported
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型。当前支持实例Instance资源
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The resource IDs. You can specify a maximum of 20 resource IDs
parameters.help_zh: 资源 ID。最多支持添加20个资源
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region in which the resources are deployed
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The key of tag N added to the resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
parameters.name: tag_key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from the resource. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false**

>If you specify both this parameter and the TagKey parameter, this parameter does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
是否解绑资源上全部的标签，取值：

- **true**：解绑资源上的全部标签。

- **false**：不解绑全部标签。

> 如果同时设置了**TagKey.n**和本参数，则本参数不生效
parameters.name: all
